Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google AI Payment Pilot, Search Profiles At 10,000 – SEO Pulse
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google is testing a payment model for content that contributes to AI answers, while John Mueller notes that AI position data is difficult to report. Cloudflare is also reported to be separating bot training traffic from search crawling.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLM Citation Study: 13,184 Citations Across 4 AI Tools | Orbit Media Studios
AI Search / GEO.summary: Orbit Media Studios analyzed over 13,000 citations across four AI tools to identify which sources and domains are most commonly referenced in AI-generated answers. The study offers data-backed insight directly relevant to GEO and AI search visibility strategy.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI | LLM Pulse
AI Search / GEO.summary: LLM Pulse tracks which domains receive the most citations across major AI answer engines including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI. This is directly actionable for enterprise teams building GEO authority strategies.

AI Search / GEO.title: Mastering Generative Engine Optimization in 2026: Full Guide
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land published a full guide to Generative Engine Optimization covering how to build visibility in AI-driven answer surfaces. As a Search Engine Land publication it carries higher editorial authority than most GEO guides in this pool.

AI Search / GEO.title: Position: Generative Engine Optimization Creates Underexamined Risks, Governance Must Target Concentration, Disclosure, and Academic Blind Spots
AI Search / GEO.summary: An academic paper argues that GEO introduces underexamined risks around source concentration and disclosure, calling for governance frameworks to address these blind spots. Relevant for enterprise SEO teams navigating brand-safety and compliance dimensions of AI search.

AI Search / GEO.title: IF-GEO: Conflict-Aware Instruction Fusion for Multi-Query Generative Engine Optimization
AI Search / GEO.summary: This arxiv paper introduces a conflict-aware instruction fusion approach for optimizing content visibility across multiple simultaneous queries in generative engines. Technically oriented research with implications for enterprise-scale GEO content structuring.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Search I/O 2026 Updates: AI Agents and More
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google's official blog covers Search announcements from I/O 2026, including updates related to AI agents integrated into Search. First-party Google source makes this the most authoritative account of current AI search direction.
